docs.summary: Alpha blending mode for a [`Material`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Material), matching glTF semantics.
The rendered output is fully opaque; any alpha channel is ignored.
The rendered output is either fully opaque or fully transparent, depending on whether the alpha sample crosses [`AlphaCutoff`](#api~Prowl.Clay.Material~AlphaCutoff).
The alpha value is used to composite the source and destination colors.
